height 3.38 studs | 58 blocks | 834 triangles | bevel 0.125 x 2 | 1 stud = 68 px
Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `starry` (Epic eye), 28 x 14 px at 16 a stud, 5 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Lightning. VFX: kept on the body (Epic), five layers in Effects.luau: a storm-yellow
arc flickers across its back between the quill rows (BackL to BackR, eight segments), sparks
leave the back at 5 a second, a violet light, a yellow catchlight sparkles in its star eyes
every 4.5 s, and the signature: every 6 s and on the flourish the quills discharge a crackle of
twelve sparks. The flourish (every 8 s) is that discharge: a hop, the bolt popping, the
lightning rods and the tail whipping, a squash on landing
